lines.zh: 我细长的腿在沙地上打拍子。
lines.en: My long thin legs tap a rhythm on the sand.

lines.zh: 两片红冠一前一后地晃。
lines.en: The two red crests sway, one behind the other.

lines.zh: 我走得轻，脖子却伸得很长。
lines.en: I walk light, but my neck stretches far ahead.

lines.zh: 绕开泥潭，我的脚趾太细。
lines.en: I skirt the mud; my toes are too slim for it.

lines.zh: 林子边缘有鸟叫，我去看看。
lines.en: Birds call at the tree line; I'll go look.
Three steps, one pause: I am listening.

lines.zh: 阳光把我的冠照得发亮。
lines.en: The sun makes my crests shine.

lines.zh: 我巡这条河边，走得很慢。
lines.en: I patrol this riverbank at a slow pace.

lines.zh: 同伴在坡上，我先走在前面。
lines.en: My mate waits upslope; I walk ahead.

lines.zh: 身上有股药味，跟着我走。
lines.en: A bitter smell follows me along the path.

lines.zh: 脚掌软，踩下去几乎没有印。
lines.en: Soft feet, so I barely leave a print.
I'm hunting small things; no need to run.
My throat moves first, then my feet.
I can fold myself into this scrub.
I crook my neck into a hook.
Something rumbles deep in my throat.
Both crests stand up; I'm alert.

lines.zh: 我没动，但我在计算距离。
lines.en: I'm still, but I'm measuring distance.
The sacs by my cheeks puff gently.
This wood is noisy today.
I grind my teeth; a little venom is plenty.

lines.zh: 风把我的冠吹得向后倒。
lines.en: The wind bends both crests backward.
My eyes half close; my ears do not.
My shadow stretches long on the ground.

lines.zh: 第三只鸟飞过，我没兴趣。
lines.en: A third bird passes; I don't care.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖颈，把尘土抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my neck free of dust.

lines.zh: 我在想该从哪条路出去。
lines.en: I'm deciding which way out to take.
Quiet as a stone, that's me.
You're standing downwind of me.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脸看了三秒。
lines.en: I stare at your face for three seconds.
My cheeks puff once; don't panic.
What you carry smells of iron.

lines.zh: 我向前一步，冠就展开了。
lines.en: One step forward and my crests flare.
You retreat, so I know you're afraid.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，是在量嘴。
lines.en: When I look at you I'm sizing my mouth.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，像在听你说话。
lines.en: I tilt my head as if listening to you.
Hold still; I haven't decided yet.

lines.zh: 我往左偏了一点，又回来。
lines.en: I lean left, then straighten again.
A growl starts low in my throat.

lines.zh: 有些猎物站着就是靶子。
lines.en: Some prey might as well wear a target.
My pupils haven't blinked in a while.
If you run, I'll simply follow.
I flatten my crests; that's a warning.
Don't think I'm small; my teeth carry venom.
I hiss; one crest goes crooked.
The pain pulls my neck back.

lines.zh: 我抿紧了嘴，毒没喷出来。
lines.en: I clamp my mouth shut; the venom stays in.
Two steps back; let me check the wound.
My hide is thin, but I won't run.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，冠歪到一边。
lines.en: One blow, and my crest lolls to one side.
I tilt my head and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 你的手劲比我以为的大。
lines.en: Your arm is stronger than I judged.
The sound in my throat drops lower.
The pain will pass; you will stay.

lines.zh: 一股生肉味，我嘴里发酸。
lines.en: Raw meat; my mouth waters at the smell.

lines.zh: 你把食物放低些，我就来。
lines.en: Lower the food and I'll come.
I circle halfway and come from behind.
Let me sniff first; don't pull it back.

lines.zh: 我蹭你的靴子，不是撒娇。
lines.en: I brush your boot, but not to be petted.
This smell makes me forget caution.
I tilt my head and wait, quite patient.

lines.zh: 再往前一寸，我就够到了。
lines.en: One inch closer and I can reach it.
While eating, I look nowhere else.
Open your palm, then I'll trust you.
Your knee knocks against my crest.
I pull back and raise my neck again.

lines.zh: 别挤，我脖子太长不好让。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; my long neck doesn't bend well.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀一碰，尘土扬起。
lines.en: Our shoulders touch and dust rises.

lines.zh: 我一歪，两片红冠扫到了你。
lines.en: I lurch, and my two red crests brush you.
You brushed my raised crest.

lines.zh: 我侧头从你腋下钻过去。
lines.en: I duck under your arm to pass.

lines.zh: 贴着走，我能闻到你的汗。
lines.en: This close, I can smell your sweat.
I push once; I'm testing you.
Make room; I'm taking this path.

lines.zh: 我把冠立得笔直，给她看。
lines.en: I raise my crests straight for her to see.
She circles; I circle with her.

lines.zh: 两只长脖子交成一道弧。
lines.en: Two long necks meet in a single arc.

lines.zh: 我叼着嫩枝放到她脚边。
lines.en: I lay a tender branch at her feet.
We make no sound; our crests do the talking.

lines.zh: 她靠过来，我挪开一点位置。
lines.en: She leans in; I shift aside to make room.

lines.zh: 这片河岸，够我们两窝用。
lines.en: This bank has room for both our nests.

lines.zh: 我站在她上风处，挡住风。
lines.en: I stand upwind of her to block it.
We walk side by side for a long while.

lines.zh: 她低头，我也跟着低下去。
lines.en: She lowers her head; I lower mine too.
A splinter of bone goes into my mouth.
This tuft of grass will line the nest.

lines.zh: 你的包裹松了，我捡到一包。
lines.en: Your pack split; I found a bundle.
A bright little thing, very light.
I tuck it behind my crest.

lines.zh: 闻起来像食物，我先拿走。
lines.en: Smells like food, so I take it first.

lines.zh: 我叼着东西时脖子更直。
lines.en: Carrying it makes my neck stand straighter.
A spilled pile of berries; mine now.
I curl my tongue and sweep it up.

lines.zh: 它滚到石头缝里，我用爪掏。
lines.en: It rolled into a crack; I dig with a claw.
Small thing, I see you.
My crests snap upright.
My throat opens first; the venom is ready.
Within three metres I can reach.
You turned, and I had you.
I lower my neck like a snake.
That sound is exactly prey.
I take one step to test the range.
My cheeks swell; stay back.
Once locked on, I rarely give up.
The wind dies, perfect for a strike.

lines.zh: 同伴让开，把位置留给我。
lines.en: My mate steps aside to give me the line.
You picked the wrong direction to run.
My teeth click together once.

lines.zh: 我跟在后面，不喊也不叫。
lines.en: I trail behind without a sound.

lines.zh: 它在跑，我的腿更细更快。
lines.en: It runs, but my legs are thinner and faster.
I cut left to block the way.
The gap keeps closing.
The venom builds in my cheeks.
I count its breaths; they've gone ragged.
Ten more strides should do it.

lines.zh: 它往树上爬，我在下面等。
lines.en: It climbs a tree; I wait below.
The grass is too short to hide prey.
No rush; the venom works on its own.
Its shadow comes nearer.
I sink down and cut from the side.
It hits a rock wall and stops.

lines.zh: 风在我背后，味道很清楚。
lines.en: The wind's at my back; the scent is clear.

lines.zh: 到了这个距离，我张开了嘴。
lines.en: At this distance, I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，毒跟着进去。
lines.en: I bite down and the venom goes with it.
One claw pins it; my long neck twists.
I spit a cloud of venom.
It covers its face and stumbles back.

lines.zh: 我把毒喷完，退到三步外。
lines.en: Once the venom is out, I step back three paces.

lines.zh: 这一口下去，剩下的交给毒。
lines.en: One bite, then the venom does the rest.
I snap my head and tear its guard open.

lines.zh: 细腿蹬地，把身体送出去。
lines.en: My thin legs push my body forward.

lines.zh: 它想还手，我早退了两步。
lines.en: It swings back; I'm already two steps away.
Where my teeth land, numbness follows.
I took it from behind.
Its footwork is falling apart.

lines.zh: 我的冠在打斗中一直竖着。
lines.en: Through the fight my crests stay rigid.
The last one, I hold and don't let go.

lines.zh: 河岸边的灌木动了一下。
lines.en: The riverside scrub shifts once.
Two red crests come out of the brush first.
I walk out of the morning mist.

lines.zh: 这片林子第一次有我的味道。
lines.en: This wood tastes my scent for the first time.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脖子，甩落露水。
lines.en: I shake my neck and fling off the dew.
Soft mud underfoot; this suits me.

lines.zh: 有猎物在附近，我闻到了。
lines.en: Prey nearby; I can smell it.
I give a low call by way of announcement.

lines.zh: 这里的天比我记得的更亮。
lines.en: The sky here is brighter than I recall.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在一排脚印上。
lines.en: My shadow falls across a line of prints.
Behind the stones, I show my head first.
Unfamiliar ground; I'll take it slowly.
A new pair of eyes in the tree shade.
I sweep the dust away with my tail.

lines.zh: 夜里我醒过来，周围全是树。
lines.en: I wake at night, surrounded by trees.
My mate hasn't arrived; I'll wait here.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出第一声咕噜。
lines.en: The first growl rises in my throat.

lines.zh: 这个世界的味道，我记下了。
lines.en: I've noted how this world smells.

lines.zh: 火焰烤到我的冠，边缘卷了。
lines.en: Flame catches my crest; the edge curls.

lines.zh: 落地时腿折了一下，我叫出声。
lines.en: My leg buckles on landing and I cry out.

lines.zh: 河水灌进口中，我乱蹬着上浮。
lines.en: Water pours into my mouth; I kick for the surface.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我掀得翻了身。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over onto my back.
An arrow stands in my flank.

lines.zh: 有股冷力钻进骨头，我看不见来处。
lines.en: Cold force enters my bones; I see no source.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连站都费劲。
lines.en: My belly is empty; even standing is work.

lines.zh: 雷砸在我冠上，我一时看不见。
lines.en: Lightning hits my crests; I go blind for a moment.

lines.zh: 空间裂开，我掉向没有底的地方。
lines.en: Space tears open; I fall into nothing.
